decisions.reason: Adding a subsection within Section 2 does not change the established order of the document's sections or permit section reordering.
The newly supplied narrative subsection does not change the requirements for incorporating or replacing proposal tables.
The Section 2 subsection is unrelated to the number, placement, or integration method of the appendix biographies.
The source requires adding Section 2 content but does not specify that the subsection must appear in the table of contents or otherwise change the existing requirement to include a table of contents.
The additional Section 2 subsection does not affect the one-page proposal letter or Canva signature-insertion behavior.
The source decision adds narrative content and does not alter the organization-chart integration requirement.
Although the added content may consume space, the source does not change the page-count target, compaction method, or page-limit compliance goal.
The newly supplied subsection does not change any required photo selection, exclusion, or placement rule.
The existing full-document coverage already applies to the complete RFQ response; adding subsection content does not change the layout approach or coverage attributes.
The source demonstrates use of Canva while supplying missing content, but it does not modify the editable-source deliverable, ownership, access, or reuse requirements.
The source does not state that the added subsection contains hyperlinks or change the requirement that existing proposal hyperlinks remain functional.
Adding content to Section 2 of the current proposal does not resume or modify the deferred reusable-template requirement.
